content.text: CHECK AND ADJUSTMENT OF BRAKE PEDAL

content.description: Diagram showing brake pedal assembly with stop light switch, pedal push rod, and pedal height measurement from asphalt sheet

items.heading: CHECK THAT PEDAL HEIGHT IS CORRECT, AS SHOWN

content.text: Pedal height from asphalt sheet: 154 — 164 mm (6.06 — 6.46 in.)

items: (a) Sufficiently loosen the stop light switch.
(b) Adjust the pedal height by turning the pedal push rod.
(c) Return the stop light switch until it lightly contacts the pedal stopper.
(d) After adjusting the pedal height, check and adjust the pedal freeplay.

content.description: Diagram showing brake pedal assembly with pedal push rod and pedal free play measurement of 3-6 mm

items.heading: CHECK THAT PEDAL FREEPLAY IS CORRECT, AS SHOWN

items: (a) Stop the engine and depress the brake pedal several times until there is no more vacuum left in the booster.
(b) Push in the pedal until the beginning of resistance is felt. Measure the distance, as shown.

content.text: NOTE: The pedal freeplay is the amount of the stroke until the booster air valve is moved by the pedal push rod.

items: (a) If incorrect, adjust the pedal freeplay by turning the pedal push rod.
(b) Start the engine and confirm that pedal freeplay exists.
(c) After adjusting the pedal freeplay, check the pedal height.

content.description: Diagram showing brake pedal with pedal reserve distance measurement from asphalt sheet

items.heading: CHECK THAT PEDAL RESERVE DISTANCE IS CORRECT, AS SHOWN

content.text: With engine running, depress the pedal and measure the pedal reserve distance, as shown.
Pedal reserve distance from asphalt sheet at 50 kg (110.2 lb, 490 N): More than 75 mm (2.95 in.)
If incorrect, troubleshoot the brake system.
